components.name: ErrorBanner
components.description: Shown when a payment is declined. The basket keeps its contents so it can be retried.

props.name: message
props.description: What went wrong, in words the customer can act on.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Called when the customer asks to try the payment again.

stories.name: Declined
stories.description: The message for any declined card.
stories.snippet: const Declined = () => <ErrorBanner message="Your card was declined." />;

stories.name: Retryable
stories.description: A retry button appears when the payment can be tried again.
stories.snippet: const Retryable = () => <ErrorBanner message="The bank timed out." onRetry={() => {}} />;

components.name: PayButton
components.description: Takes the payment. Disabled while one is in flight, so a double click cannot pay twice.

props.name: amount
props.description: The amount shown on the button, already formatted.

props.name: busy
props.description: Disables the button while a payment is in flight.
